name: nhcx
description: Run /nhcx-start after installing: it says what this plugin does, offers prompts to start from, and asks what you are building. Agent skills for building the provider side of the National Health Claims Exchange (NHCX) into a hospital information system: nhcx-full for the whole integration, and one skill per use case, nhcx-coverage, nhcx-preauth, nhcx-claim, nhcx-communication, nhcx-payment and nhcx-reprocess. Each works through eight logged steps from discovery to sandbox tests, takes its NHCX facts from the nhcx-docs MCP server or the NHCX package, and installs and runs alone. Connects the nhcx-docs MCP server, and carries /nhcx-decode-error, /nhcx-preflight and /nhcx-prove-seal, and the nhcx-call-debugger agent.
